items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: somebody gave this guy Scott Hamilton a play, and to me, he was playing within the structure

ctx.x: And now the only way they will make a jazz record now if it's gimmicky, if it's like Coltrane with a guy squealing or doing some other outlandish thing that's different.

But one guy -- and I have to give him credit, somebody gave this guy Scott Hamilton a play, and to me, he was playing within the structure, within the 32-bar structure, and he's only a 20-year-old guy, playing in the same old structure, but playing something new in ...
